development_objective: Mean observed nDCG@5 over Oracle E, F and G. Ties prefer smaller depth, then smaller strength.
metric_policy: Macro over queries with known positives, nDCG based on known grades and 2^grade-1 gain. Count the unjudged separately at each depth. Strict Hit/MRR/Recall use grade 2. Bootstrap samples whole paired queries.
oracle: Constrain development and independent evaluation with the frozen human-readable structured annotations.
end_to_end: Use one real validated Query Understanding result per query for E, F and G. Missing or rejected extraction preserves the input order.
regression: Replay immutable A–D rankings from 5.4-1D-1 separately for its 40 evaluation queries and the 18 queries from 5.4-1C. Rerun extraction and evaluation with current read-only metadata.
